# artifact-selection — When to Generate Each Artifact

## When to Apply

At the start of every `coe-sdd-plan` run, before generating any artifact.
Announce what will be created and what will be omitted — with justification.
Ask for confirmation before proceeding.

## Announcement Format

```
Artifacts to generate: spec, plan, tasks, checklists/requirements, [conditional list]
Omitted: [artifact] ([reason])
~N tasks estimated.
Proceed? (yes / adjust / no)
```

## Core — Always Generated by coe-sdd-plan

| Artifact | Notes |
|----------|-------|
| `spec.md` | User stories, FR/BR refs, edge cases, out of scope |
| `plan.md` | Tech context, code structure, constitution check |
| `tasks.md` | Unified format with gate commands |
| `checklists/requirements.md` | Spec quality check (max 1 fix iteration) |

## Conditional — Generated Only When the Work Requires It

| Artifact | Generate when | Skip when |
|----------|---------------|-----------|
| `research.md` | Relevant technical decision must be made, or `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers exist in spec | Technical approach is clear and already established in the codebase |
| `data-model.md` | New or changed entities, tables, schema, or state transitions | Milestone touches no data model |
| `contracts/` | Milestone exposes an interface: internal or public HTTP API, CLI commands, event schemas, UI contracts | Milestone is purely internal (build scripts, config, migrations with no interface change) |
| `quickstart.md` | Non-trivial E2E or manual validation is needed to prove the feature works | Unit/integration tests fully cover validation; no manual steps required |
| `context.md` | `discuss` was explicitly triggered — architectural or UX gray areas debated with the user | No architectural ambiguity requiring a recorded decision trail |

## Escalation

If during plan generation a new entity, interface, or technical decision emerges that was not in the initial selection:

1. Stop the current phase
2. Re-announce updated artifact list with rationale for the addition
3. Ask for confirmation before continuing
